_comment: Template for awowlab.config.json, which holds every value a fork sets: where the build points, its WarcraftLogs client and its keys. CMake copies it on the first configure and fills settings_key with a random value; edit the copy, never commit it. Fields added to this template later are copied into your file on the next configure. The repositories here are placeholders. WarcraftLogs sign-in needs only wcl_client_id and the redirect ports; it never sends the client secret, so there is no field for it. See docs/BUILD-OPTIONS.md. Only the public half of the signing key goes in signing_public_key; signing_key_path names the private key file, which stays outside the repository (tools/release/SIGNING.md).
